title: Smoky Baingan Bharta from scratch 🍆🔥 village style #shorts

segments.moment_description: Harvesting fresh brinjals (eggplant) in the garden
Gathering tomatoes, onions and garlic from the garden
Walking home with the basket of vegetables
Roasting the brinjal over open fire until smoky and charred
Mashing and cooking the smoky baingan bharta
Sharing the baingan bharta meal together

description:
Smoky Baingan Bharta 🍆🔥 — brinjal fire-roasted till charred, then mashed and cooked with tomatoes, onions and spices the old village way. That smoky flavour hits different.

Baingan bharta with roti or rice — what's your combo? 👇 Comment below!

🌿 Made with fire-roasted eggplant, tomatoes, onion, garlic and green chilli in mustard oil — pure smoky comfort food.

Did you know? The smoky taste comes only from roasting the brinjal directly on an open flame — that char is what gives baingan bharta its signature flavour.
